motive.zhHans: 被逼到穷途末路后，Kaishiro 供认了罪行，并说出在毛利小五郎一行离开后，Nagisa 曾宣布她要去见一个人：「要是顺利的话，我就把离婚协议书寄给你（……）说到底，这个世界是由长相和金钱统治的。死心吧。」她当初是为了钱才嫁给 Kaishiro 的。
motive.en: Caught, Kaishiro confesses to the crime, revealing that after Kogoro's group had left, Nagisa had announced that she was meeting someone: "If it goes well, I'm sending you the divorce papers(...)in the end, the world is ruled by looks and money. Give it up." She had married Kaishiro for the money.

method.zhHans: 接着柯南借毛利小五郎之口揭露，这是一桩伪装成意外的谋杀案；凶手就是 Kaishiro Imaoka。证据是 Nagisa 做到一半的足部美甲，说明她原本并没有打算冲浪，以及她潜水服下面的勒痕：那套潜水服是她死后才被穿上去的。Kaishiro 抗议说尸体没有力气穿上潜水服（因为潜水服很紧），毛利小五郎（其实是柯南的声音）便让警方在一名志愿者的脚上演示了这个手法。柯南进一步解释，Kaishiro 杀死妻子后先把她埋进沙子里，之后用纸板「履带」把她运到浪边——纸板两端粘接在一起，他用起来很像仓鼠的滚轮，因此在搬运 Nagisa 尸体时没有留下任何脚印。
method.en: Through Kogoro, Conan then reveals that this is a murder case disguised as an accident; the culprit is Kaishiro Imaoka. The proof is Nagisa's half-finished pedicure, indicating she hadn't planned to surf, and the strangle mark under her wetsuit: she wore the suit after her death. Kaishiro protests that a corpse lacks the strength to wear a wetsuit (due to the suit's tightness), and Kogoro (Conan's voice) has the police demonstrate the trick with plastic bags on a volunteer's feet. Conan goes on to explain that after killing his wife, Kaishiro buried her in the sand, later bringing her to the edge of the waves with cardboard 'treads': cardboard stuck together at the ends he used much like a hamster's wheel, allowing him to leave no tracks as he carried Nagisa's corpse.

resolution.zhHans: 首先，Nagisa 被证实是 35 岁，而不是 25 岁。接着柯南借毛利小五郎之口揭露，这是一桩伪装成意外的谋杀案；凶手就是 Kaishiro Imaoka。证据是 Nagisa 做到一半的足部美甲，说明她原本并没有打算冲浪，以及她潜水服下面的勒痕：那套潜水服是她死后才被穿上去的。Kaishiro 抗议说尸体没有力气穿上潜水服（因为潜水服很紧），毛利小五郎（其实是柯南的声音）便让警方在一名志愿者的脚上演示了这个手法。他解释说塑料袋能减小摩擦，让人轻易套上潜水服。随后毛利兰拿出一个盒子，里面装着两个同样的塑料袋，上面的污渍与 Nagisa 的足部美甲相符。柯南进一步解释，Kaishiro 杀死妻子后先把她埋进沙子里，之后用纸板「履带」把她运到浪边——纸板两端粘接在一起，他用起来很像仓鼠的滚轮，因此在搬运 Nagisa 尸体时没有留下任何脚印。被逼到穷途末路后，Kaishiro 供认了罪行，并说出在毛利小五郎一行离开后，Nagisa 曾宣布她要去见一个人：「要是顺利的话，我就把离婚协议书寄给你（……）说到底，这个世界是由长相和金钱统治的。死心吧。」她当初是为了钱才嫁给 Kaishiro 的。
resolution.en: Nagisa is first shown to be 35 years old, and not 25. Through Kogoro, Conan then reveals that this is a murder case disguised as an accident; the culprit is Kaishiro Imaoka. The proof is Nagisa's half-finished pedicure, indicating she hadn't planned to surf, and the strangle mark under her wetsuit: she wore the suit after her death. Kaishiro protests that a corpse lacks the strength to wear a wetsuit (due to the suit's tightness), and Kogoro (Conan's voice) has the police demonstrate the trick with plastic bags on a volunteer's feet. He explains that the bags reduce friction, making it easy to slip on a wetsuit. Ran then brings forth a box containing two similar bags with stains matching Nagisa's pedicure. Conan goes on to explain that after killing his wife, Kaishiro buried her in the sand, later bringing her to the edge of the waves with cardboard 'treads': cardboard stuck together at the ends he used much like a hamster's wheel, allowing him to leave no tracks as he carried Nagisa's corpse. Caught, Kaishiro confesses to the crime, revealing that after Kogoro's group had left, Nagisa had announced that she was meeting someone: "If it goes well, I'm sending you the divorce papers(...)in the end, the world is ruled by looks and money. Give it up." She had married Kaishiro for the money.

summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro went to Ohama Coast from Beika Street for two hours and they are going to have fun surfing at the beach. First of all, the reason why Kogoro wants to go surfing is because of the woman named Nagisa Imaoka. She invited Kogoro. While at the beach, Nagisa is pretty good at surfing.
